Manufacturing linked capacity scheme (RFS No SECI/C&P/RfS/2GW Manufacturing/P-3/R1/062019 dated 25.06.2019)

ISTS charges shall be waived for Solar PV power plants commissioned under SECI Tender for manufacturing linked capacity scheme (RFS No SECI/C&P/RfS/2GW Manufacturing/P-3/R1/062019 dated 25.06.2019) for sale to entities having RPO, irrespective of whether this power is within RPO or not.
